answers.answer: Threat Models are not present or if present are mostly ignored and unused to improve other aspects of development

scoringQuestions.question: what methodologies are used for threat modeling?

answers.answer: No use of any methodologies or no analysis
Standard methodologies for example:data flow analysis, STRIDE, attack trees, trust boundaries definition, etc.

answers.answer: No analysis at all
Mostly high level of abstraction, for example Data Flow Diagrams and high level architecture and system views
Mostly high and Medium level of abstraction, for example single processes and their communications, microservices, individual storage of sensitive information detailed
Both high level and single features level (single API endpoints, sequence diagrams, feature abuse cases)
